# rework claims, round 2 (policy-task audit revision_1)

- CG-U1 → the sale-notice policy now declares overwrites of the earliest-sale-date clauses in base recovery_reinstatement (reinstatement before the sale date) and recovery_disposition (sale on or after it). Each self-naming replaced_by defines the earliest sale date as the latest date stated in a notice that allows at least the class minimum period, keeps the calendar counting and the too-late/allowed endpoint, and says what happens while no such notice stands. Both base policies are now in base_policy_refs.
- CG-U2 → the "0.00 while no quote stands" departure is removed. The notice states 0.00 only where reinstatement is not available (limit reached or charged off), and otherwise the amount a same-day reinstatement quote states (the base meaning). The task 1 seeded notice was re-priced to that quote amount.
- CG-S1 → business_day_notice_days was raised, so the business-day tier always gives at least the 15-day minimum on every mailing weekday (brute-forced). The rule no longer prescribes a notice it declares short.
- CG-S2 → the sibling storage sentence now says a quote's expense portion uses the matching borrower expense payment rule. The class-rate clause is kept only for storage posted on release or sale. The reinstatement overwrite says a quote's expenses_usd is that payment figure, with storage through the quote's good-through date.
- CG-S3 → the low-value tier of both fee policies now names "the collateral class's fee, taken before any state limit" as the figure compared with the book-value percentage. Compute is unchanged and no factor reads another factor's output.
- CG-P1 → prerequisite E2 is reworded so its sentence, its condition and its compute all read the same thing: the notice stating the latest earliest sale date. The edge condition and effect texts were updated to match.
- CG-T1 → the storage end date of both payment policies uses the latest stated earliest sale date (LATEST by deadline_date), not the latest mailing date. Same-day rows can no longer pick different notices. Rule, basis and compute were changed together.
- CG-Z1 → both fee policies gain a realistic minimum (agency_fee_minimum_usd, surrender_fee_minimum_usd) applied in the assembly sentence and compute. A posted fee can never be 0.00. The surrender tool docstring now requires a positive amount.
- CG-M1 → the mid tier of both value-reduction method factors is now a taper on how far the book value falls short of the mid threshold. It reads the book value, so every tier pair differs in shape. Taper percentages were chosen to keep the fee near-continuous at the low/mid boundary.
- CG-R1 → prior_reinstatement_days is removed. It is replaced by late_mailing_days: extra days when the notice is mailed long after the recovery date, a UCC 9-611/9-612 reasonableness allowance read from the case's own dates. The contract reinstatement-payment reads were dropped from cross_category and inputs.
- CG-R2 → the non-dividing program-start conjuncts are removed. Extended lot grace now requires payment within extended_grace_window_days of recovery, and no-grace lots apply unconditionally. The drop-off credit is split into a staffed weekday drop-off tier and an after-hours weekend drop tier; dealer drop-off lots were removed.
- O-2 → the left-service tier now reads "no fewer rate_cap_ended rows", so applied < ended is covered.
- O-4 → the returned-payment window states the whole-month boundary explicitly.
- T0-F1 → closed through CG-M1: the task 0 agency fee takes the taper method tier.
- T0-F2 → closed through CG-R1: the task 0 sale period takes late_mailing_days instead of the removed factor. Its scored period, notice date and every downstream figure were recomputed by the gates.
- T0-P1 (a)–(g) → design_rationale, factor_trace, factor_sensitivity.tier_taken and every argument_uniqueness_tracing entry were regenerated. Tier text is copied verbatim from the charter ladders, including the key-fee conjunct and the new grace-window and taper wording. The problem-tree text lists all four expense rows. The 2025 case's seeded fee, settlement and notice date were re-priced under the current rules.
- T1-F1 → closed through CG-M1: the task 1 surrender fee takes the taper method tier. Values, sensitivities and traces were recomputed.
- T1-P1 → design_rationale now claims only keyless_lot_handling as multi-source. It states that the drop-off and lot-grace factors read one case row.
- Persona channels (observation) → task 1's husband now pays the installments by MoneyGram and task 0's credit union wires the payoff, both certified channels. The borrowers pay by debit card.
- Probe sweep → plan.md carries the adversarial probe table: decoy, absent, same-day tie, zero, negative, boundary and cap cases for every read of all five policies.
